scenarios.description: A GDScript edit must keep typed signal signatures and presentation-manifest contracts intact: the manifest must still resolve abstract units/buildings to concrete visual resources, atlas rects must stay within PNG bounds, and no hardcoded entity drift may be introduced.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Presentation scene verifier exits 0 (manifest valid, atlas in bounds, abstract mappings resolve, no hardcoded drift); presentation manifest tests pass confirming the typed script contract still holds after the edit.

scenarios.description: A GDScript change must not break combat event ownership — the frontend must continue to attribute combat events to the correct source unit and target. A regression that re-routes or drops events between SimCore and the presentation layer must be caught.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Combat event contract tests pass, confirming event ownership (source/target/entity-type) is preserved across the SimCore→Frontend boundary after the GDScript edit; no event is silently dropped or misattributed.
